title: Best Stretch With One Skip
statement:
Pick a stretch of consecutive numbers from the array. You may skip (delete) at most one number inside the stretch, and at least one number must remain after skipping. Find the largest possible sum of the remaining numbers.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the largest possible sum.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 22000`
- `-10^6 <= a_i <= 10^6`
